article_title: Community structure of pollination webs of Mauritian heathland habitats

networks: restored site with introduced plants removed
weight_families: visitation rate based on visits per flower per hour, averaged by total observation time
fully quantitative interaction data accounting for total floral abundance at a site

primary_choice_reason: fixed from the source's explicit visitation-rate definition before metric inspection; the fully quantitative matrices are retained as a prespecified sensitivity if source sheet identity is unambiguous
aggregation_rule: Do not combine control and restored networks for primary source-native Tier-B. They are nested network observations within the single Mauritius system and must be held out together in cross-system validation.
claim_boundary: Visitation rate/interaction strength is a quantitative flower-visitation measure, not single-visit pollinator effectiveness or reproductive success. Workbook sheets must be identified from source labels/layout, not by which metric values best match Doré.
